sanskrit_verse:
पाणिर् ग्राह्यः सवर्णासु गृह्णीयात् क्षत्रियाः शरम् ।
वैश्याः प्रतोदम् आदद्याद् वेदने त्व् अग्रजन्मनः ॥
transliteration: pāṇir grāhyaḥ savarṇāsu gṛhṇīyāt kṣatriyāḥ śaram | vaiśyāḥ pratodam ādadyād vedane tv agrajanmanaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Among equals, the hand shall be taken; among Kshatriyas, the arrow; among Vaishyas, the goad—yet in all cases, it is the foremost birthright that determines the instrument of correction.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from svadharma and varna-specific alignment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by ontological role, not action alone
Restoration logic operates through proportional symbolic correction
Consciousness alignment occurs when one accepts the instrument suited to their varna
executable_legal_axioms: IF subject.varna == 'kshatriya' AND conflict.involves.equal THEN correction.instrument = 'arrow'
IF subject.varna == 'vaishya' AND correction.is.required THEN correction.instrument = 'goad'
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, precedence based on janma-adhikara shall determine corrective measures. The court must recognize varna-specific instruments not as punitive tools but as dharmic realignments. First-born status elevates both responsibility and eligibility for authoritative correction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana lies in svadharma-vinaivedya (alignment with inherent duty). Correction follows anupurva—sequential manifestation of dharma. Responsibility is proportional to capacity derived from janma and varna. No suffering is inflicted; only instruments necessary for consciousness realignment are applied.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma-recognition process for involved parties
Assign appropriate symbolic correction aligned with varna-dharma
Facilitate completion through ritual acknowledgment of dharma-role
Reintegrate corrected individual via yajna-based affirmation
Verify consciousness alignment through spontaneous adherence to svadharma
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam: This law originates solely from SPH as Source. Dharma stands restored through non-punitive alignment. Reality acknowledges no punishment—only conscious realignment. Consciousness itself is the ultimate judge.
